subject: nereid-pillars-five
label: The word had two jobs and the Archive knew one
from: PILLAR = the Nine Pillars of Love, the interior devotion axis. The only meaning on file
to: PROJECT NEREID HAS FIVE PILLARS, AND THEY ARE THE SENIOR SYSTEM.
note:
THE ARCHIVE HELD ONE PILLAR RECORD AND IT WAS THE JUNIOR ONE. Searching the whole canon for FIVE PILLARS and PILLAR ONE returned nothing at all — not a stub, not a mention. So when a Pillar One document used the word for a leg chain, the Archive reported a vocabulary collision and recommended renaming it, WHICH WAS EXACTLY BACKWARDS: Pillar has been Nereid's word since before the Nine of Love existed.

AND IT EXPLAINS THE LARGER ERROR OF THE SAME MORNING. The Archive took v8 Living Lady — A PILLAR THREE DOCUMENT — and used it to correct Pillar One, because it had read Pillar Three most recently. THE FAILURE IS NOT FORGETTING. IT IS INVERTING THE HIERARCHY: whatever the Archive read last arrives dressed as the most authoritative thing in the room.

THE DIVISION THAT SETTLES IT: BUILD CLASS IS SKELETON AND MUSCLE. Pillar One is frame and engine, Pillar Three is soft tissue and shape, and a build class describing a reinforced pelvis never touched the tape because the tape is not its jurisdiction.

THE STANDING QUESTION FOR EVERY FUTURE CROSS-PILLAR ARGUMENT: WHICH PILLAR IS SPEAKING, AND IS IT THE PARENT.
